title: Objectwise Grothendieck spectral sequence indexed by natural numbers
statement: Let A and B be Grothendieck abelian categories and C an abelian category. Let F : A → B and G : B → C be additive left exact functors, and assume F sends injectives to G-acyclic objects [def-sp-composite-acyclicity]. For every object M of A there is a first-quadrant cohomological spectral sequence indexed by natural numbers with E₂(p,q) isomorphic to RᵖG(RᑫF(M)), and a finite decreasing filtration on Rⁿ(G ∘ F)(M) whose p-th graded quotient is E∞(p,n-p). No Cartan–Eilenberg model or edge-map assertion is required.

proof.text: Choose standard derived categories. Resolve M injectively [def-sp-injective-resolutions] and form K=RF(M[0]); K has no negative cohomology. Apply RG to the canonical intervals of the truncation filtration of K to form the existing source-library grothendieckSpectralObject. Left exactness gives its first-quadrant vanishing. Its natural-number E₂ spectral sequence is grothendieckSpectralSequence. These constructions are defined in the cited source module.

On the interval [q,q+1), the truncated K is Hᑫ(K)[-q]. Commutation of RG and cohomology with shifts identifies Hᵖ⁺ᑫ(RG(Hᑫ(K)[-q])) with RᵖG(Hᑫ(K)); injective-resolution comparison [lem-sp-derived-well-defined] identifies Hᑫ(K) with RᑫF(M). Compose this isomorphism with the spectral-object first-page computation. This is precisely the source module nonempty_grothendieckSpectralSequence_page_two_iso.

The first-quadrant spectral-object abutment [lem-sp-first-quadrant-spectral-object-abutment] supplies a finite image filtration on Hⁿ(RG(K)). An injective resolution J of M gives K represented by F(J); its terms are G-acyclic by [def-sp-composite-acyclicity]. The acyclic-resolution computation therefore identifies Hⁿ(RG(K)) with Hⁿ(G(F(J))), and injective-resolution comparison identifies the latter with Rⁿ(F ⋙ G)(M). Transport the finite filtration and its graded-piece isomorphisms along this identification. The source implements this as nonempty_grothendieckSpectralObject_H_bot_top_iso and grothendieckSpectralSequence_abutsTo. Pair the page identifications and this abutment for grothendieckSpectralSequence to obtain the existential statement.

theorem Functor.exists_grothendieckSpectralSequence (F : A ⥤ B) (G : B ⥤ C)
    [F.Additive] [G.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteLimits G]
    (hFG : F.IsAcyclicComposablePair G) (X : A) :
    ∃ E : E₂CohomologicalSpectralSequenceNat C,
      (∀ p q : ℕ,
        Nonempty ((E.page 2).X (p, q) ≅ (G.rightDerived p).obj ((F.rightDerived q).obj X))) ∧
      E.AbutsTo (fun n ↦ ((F ⋙ G).rightDerived n).obj X)
